rows.en: Looks like you made it back in one piece.
I'm counting on you next time too.
I look forward to seeing how you grow.
You're quite skilled. Keep it up.
Seems you've grown enough to keep up with me.
I'm really glad you're my partner.
I acknowledged you. This much is a given.
Come to a concert with me sometime. Kiichiro Tokugawa's.
rows.notes: Tail heard as 'Tokugawa Kiichirou no na' (the name of); read as '...no na' (one of his). Kiichiro Tokugawa (a singer, presumably) is not in the glossary.

rows.en: Amazing you'd show up on a battlefield with skills like that.
Looks like I'd be more efficient alone.
Don't go sticking your hand in too much.
rows.notes: amari te wo dasu n ja nai zo.

rows.en: Don't do anything reckless.
Let's go! Follow me!
Don't let the battlefield swallow you.
I'll be relying on you.
Don't die. That's all I can tell you.
I have high hopes for you.
I'm counting on you, partner.
We can do it. After all, I've got you.
I'll watch your back.
From now on, I'll do it alone.
I didn't think you'd be this worthless.
If you don't want to die, never set foot on a battlefield again.
Glad you made it back safely.
Mission successful. Shall we head back too?
Not bad. I'm counting on you next time too.
Excellent results. Impressive as always.
I'm glad you lived up to my expectations.
Your work was a sight to behold.
You're a really dependable partner.
I look forward to staying your partner.
To think you'd be the one watching my back. You've grown.
Rabbit 1, starting interception. If you don't want to die, get out of my sight!
rows.notes: Callsign 'Rabitto Wan' (Rabbit 1) is not in the glossary.

rows.en: Drop dead, you monsters!
I'm heading out, Eddie.
rows.notes: Edi (Eddie) is not in the glossary; same name as pf_cnr/136.

rows.en: I'll fly gently. As much as I can.
For our future!
That much is only natural!
Well done! You've earned my praise!
rows.notes: 'homedeiaru' read as homete yaru (I'll praise you).

rows.en: Looks like you need cover.
Fall back!
Keep that up and you're in danger!
They got you?
Answer me!
Is this my fault?
Impressive!
What an incredible performance!
You're late, Michel!
Quit dawdling, Michel!
That much is only natural.
Well done.
Fall back!
Never thought it would end like this.
Impressive.
An incredible performance.
Let's go, Michel! Formation MM Jenius! Don't you dare miss!
What?!
I can't fall behind either.
I can do that much too!
This is getting dangerous!
Please fall back and regroup!
I'll back you up.
Please eject, quickly!
No... How could this...
All because I wasn't good enough...
Amazing! I need to learn from you!
Impressive as always.
You two, don't forget this is a movie shoot!
rows.notes: eiga no satsuei (the Bird Human film mission).

rows.en: You two are getting way too worked up!
All the best parts got taken, huh.
rows.notes: ii tokoro wa minna motte ikarechaimashita ne: who took them (and from whom) is not stated; kept the agentless passive.

rows.en: I won't let you hog all the glory.
I'd better show off a little too.
I'll move in to cover you.
rows.notes: Polite register (enjo ni mairimasu) in the TF partner lines 210-217.

rows.en: Please fall back!
That's way too reckless, even for you!
Don't tell me they got you?
Damn! Like hell I'll accept this!
Because my cover came too late...
Splendid skill.
I can't fall behind either.
